cards.front: How many sides do a triangle and a square have altogether?
cards.say: How many sides do a triangle and a square have altogether? Seven sides. Three plus four equals seven.

cards.front: How many vertices do 2 hexagons have altogether?
cards.back: 12 vertices. 6 + 6 = 12.
cards.say: How many vertices do two hexagons have altogether? Twelve vertices. Six plus six equals twelve.

cards.front: How is a square different from a rectangle?
cards.back: A square has 4 equal sides. A rectangle has 2 pairs of equal sides, and the pairs can be different lengths.
cards.say: How is a square different from a rectangle? A square has four equal sides. A rectangle has two pairs of equal sides, and the pairs can be different lengths.

cards.back: A fold line that makes two halves that match exactly, like a mirror.
cards.say: Line of symmetry. A fold line that makes two halves that match exactly, like a mirror.

cards.back: A shape is symmetrical if one half is a mirror image of the other half.
cards.say: Symmetrical. A shape is symmetrical if one half is a mirror image of the other half.

cards.front: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have?
cards.back: 2. One down the middle and one across the middle.
cards.say: How many lines of symmetry does a rectangle have? Two. One down the middle and one across the middle.

cards.front: How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
cards.back: 4. Two across the middle, and two corner to corner.
cards.say: How many lines of symmetry does a square have? Four. Two across the middle, and two corner to corner.

cards.front: Does the letter A have a line of symmetry?
cards.back: Yes. It has 1 line, down the middle.
cards.say: Does the letter A have a line of symmetry? Yes. It has one line, down the middle.

cards.front: Does the letter H have a line of symmetry?
cards.back: Yes. It has 2 lines: down the middle and across the middle.
cards.say: Does the letter H have a line of symmetry? Yes. It has two lines: down the middle and across the middle.

cards.front: Does the letter B have a line of symmetry?
cards.back: Yes. One line across the middle.
cards.say: Does the letter B have a line of symmetry? Yes. One line across the middle.

cards.front: Does the letter F have a line of symmetry?
cards.back: No. No fold makes the two halves match.
cards.say: Does the letter F have a line of symmetry? No. No fold makes the two halves match.

cards.front: Does the letter L have a line of symmetry?
cards.back: No.
cards.say: Does the letter L have a line of symmetry? No.

cards.front: A butterfly is symmetrical. Where is the line of symmetry?
cards.back: Down the middle of its body.
cards.say: A butterfly is symmetrical. Where is the line of symmetry? Down the middle of its body.
